title: Rapid hotpatch + observability play for intermittent 5xx waves during tenant migrations
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Several enterprise customers reported short-lived but recurring 5xx spikes and timeouts coinciding with tenant migration windows. Initial signal: increased proxy 502/504 ratios + partial KV cache misses during migration handoff. Impacted stacks: Hosted API front-proxy -> request-router -> runtime pool. Customers saw timeouts and amplified retries which caused cascade to other tenants. This ticket is the rapid hotpatch + observability play to: (1) deploy a minimal, reversible hotfix to reduce customer-visible errors; (2) add targeted telemetry so we can attribute root cause; (3) run a controlled canary and rollback plan; (4) coordinate customer comms for affected tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Hotpatch deployed to canary and reducing 5xx rate by >80% for canary tenants
New telemetry surfaces: migration_id, cache_eviction_reason, kernel_select_latency, request_router_queue_depth
Automated canary rollback if 5xx rate increases >10% over baseline
Customer success briefed and two impacted customers given temporary workaround guidance
Postmortem outline created and linked to incident channel
decision_log: 2025-02-18: Decided to avoid large runtime changes during migration windows. Opted for a small router-side guard and backoff policy as hotpatch.
2025-02-19: Agreed to instrument migration_id in tracing and add a lightweight histogram for kernel selection latency in the next 24h.
2025-02-20: Canaries will be tenant-scoped and run in north-virginia region first; rollback policy defined (automatic + manual escalation).
work_items: Implement router guard to short-circuit requests flagged as in-flight migration until KV cache stable (ENG change)
Add migration_id tag to all traces + emit cache_eviction_reason as metric (observability)
Deploy hotpatch to 5% of host pool (canary) and monitor RTT and 5xx ratio (ops)
Create runbook entries for CS with temporary workaround: pinning to dedicated node or delay migration window (customer-facing)
Prepare PR with unit + integration tests for guard behavior and add e2e that simulates migration race

rollback_plan: Automatic rollback trigger: canary 5xx rate >10% above baseline sustained for 5 minutes
Manual rollback: ops can flip the router feature-flag (router.migration-guard.enabled=false)
If rollback fails or increases errors, escalate to runtime on-call and open emergency incident (page: runtime-oncall)
Notify customers via CS with ETA and mitigation steps
postmortem_actions: Root cause: migration handoff race between KV cache population and kernel-selection path. Need longer-term fix in runtime initialization path.
Medium-term: make kernel selector resilient to empty/partial cache and add idempotent warmup RPC before route acceptance.
Long-term: migrate tenant handoff to a controlled draining protocol with backpressure signals and observability hooks.
SLA & CS: Define clear migration window SLAs and pre-migration checks for large customers; communicate recommended migration procedures in docs.
Add automated chaos tests for migration scenarios to CI for release-branches
